pillars.title: Authentic Moments
pillars.subtitle: Unscripted, documentary coverage
pillars.description: Observational wedding storytelling capturing candid tears, eruptive belly laughs, quiet glances, and real human connection without stage direction or interruptions.

pillars.title: ‘Two Of You’ photos
pillars.subtitle: Relaxed, unposed couple portraits
pillars.description: You want natural photos and may feel uneasy about stiff posing. Why should photos of you together be awkward? It’s simply a 15-minute breather where you catch your breath as newlyweds in golden light.

pillars.title: Sense of Place
pillars.subtitle: Landscape & architectural atmosphere
pillars.description: The third part of the trilogy that ties my coverage together is telling the story of where you are getting married. From rugged Jurassic cliffs and rolling Dorset downs to historic manor houses and country barns.

craftAndDetails.title: Group Photos Made Easy
craftAndDetails.subtitle: Fast, relaxed family groupings
craftAndDetails.description: Group photos shouldn’t take an hour and bore your guests. With careful pre-planning and swift, cheerful direction, we get 6 to 8 essential family groupings completed in under 15 minutes, letting everyone get back to champagne and canapés.

craftAndDetails.title: Fine Art Albums & Presentation
craftAndDetails.subtitle: Heirloom books designed to last generations
craftAndDetails.description: Handcrafted Queensberry and Folio fine-art books bound in British leather or archival linen, printed with pigment inks on museum cotton paper designed to endure for over a century.

craftAndDetails.title: 35mm Analogue Film Craft
craftAndDetails.subtitle: Organic film grain & timeless nostalgia
craftAndDetails.description: Optional authentic Kodak Portra & Ilford black & white 35mm analogue film frames running alongside high-resolution digital cameras for unmatched organic grain, warmth, and nostalgia.

testimonials.quote: Robin has a unique gift for harnessing the power of light to create images that are nothing short of breathtaking. He blended in like an old friend, and our gallery captured the emotion of the day in a way we couldn't have imagined.

Robin is an incredible photographer – his ability to find and capture moments, to choose the best light and craft gorgeous images is second to none. He made us feel completely relaxed, and the ‘two of you’ session was one of our favourite parts of the day.
Looking through our wedding photos felt like reliving every laugh, every tear, and every hug. There wasn’t a single awkward pose – Robin has a true genius for observational documentary storytelling.
